blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: «The genitive case is used to denote the possessor or owner … A noun in the genitive case is sometimes used to qualify (modify) another noun.» — DLI, Lesson 23.
